Package net.murat.uikit

Class MOptionPane

java.lang.Object
net.murat.uikit.MOptionPane
public class MOptionPane extends Object
MOptionPane is a lightweight JOptionPane alternative for Android. Fully compatible with Android API 29 and legacy Java 6-8 without lambda expressions. All internal source code comments follow strict English standards.

    • showInputDialog

      public void showInputDialog(String message, String defaultText, MOptionPane.OnInputListener listener)
      High-comfort input dialog that pre-populates the text field with a default configuration state. Bypasses the keyboard ghosting issue by introducing a micro-delay handler. This allows the OS to finish the keyboard hide animation before downstream heavy UI tasks execute.
